Diagnosed, not fixed, and the fused-op hypothesis is now checked and ruled out: the complete arithmetic chain -- ftCo_Dash_Enter's initial-velocity delta, and both of frame -26's and frame -25's own ftCo_Dash_Phys friction/acceleration steps (fighter::locomotion helpers translating getAccelAndTarget/ftCommon_8007C98C bit-for-bit) -- was checked against the exact real bit patterns the native simulation itself produces (via a temporary c-oracle differential probe against tests/oracle's host-compiled decomp C, not committed), and every single step already matches the host-compiled C exactly, including the gr_vel value (0x3fe8f5c2) feeding the diverging frame. So the retail PowerPC binary computes this exact chain with the same separately-rounded multiply-then-add arithmetic this Rust port does, and a fused product+sum rounding once instead of twice is not the explanation.
